maria (PM): starting a tight decision thread for reserved-pool admission rules. need final before next sprint planning.

jon (Eng-Platform): proposed minimal runtime policy: evaluate in order -> explicit_guarantee flag, sla_tier, recent_burn_score, burst_window. cheap bitmask checks.

deepa (SRE): add a fused degradation signal: if pool p99 increases >10% in 1m, reduce opportunistic admits immediately.

leo (Data): for tie-breaks use committed_capacity_ratio (committed / peak) to prefer committed tenants. reduces noisy-spike gaming.

carla (Customer Success): customers want clear denial codes and suggested next steps in Console (e.g., "upgrade to reserved" or "try later"). also an opt-in guaranteed checkbox for enterprise onboarding.

jon (Eng-Platform): runtime sketch (pseudocode):

```
flags = cached_flags(tenant) // 5s TTL
if (flags.explicit_guarantee && pool.available>=req.size) return ADMIT, "guaranteed"
score = sla_weight - burn_score + burst_bonus
if (score > admit_threshold) return ADMIT, "score_admit"
if (score > queue_threshold) return QUEUE, "queued_due_to_load"
return PREEMPTABLE, "opportunistic"
```

jon (Eng-Platform): will implement short-circuit in routing layer to avoid per-request DB calls.

deepa (SRE): constraints: max_preempt_per_minute per-pool, and circuit-breaker: if preempt_rate>0.5% or queue_latency>200ms, flip to conservative mode.

maria (PM): rollout acceptance criteria: (1) canary p99 impact <=5%, (2) preempt events per-alpha-tenant <=2/day, (3) deny codes surfaced in Console, (4) feature-flagged rollout by region.

test-bot: scheduled: canary-sim job queued 1767777785 for synthetic bursts.

carla (Customer Success): will prep UX copy and onboarding toggle.

maria (PM): action items: jon -> prototype evaluator + caching; deepa -> formalize circuit thresholds; leo -> run pre-sim analytics to set burn_score thresholds; carla -> console copy; i'll collate and publish decision doc. target: canary next Tue. :rocket:
